title: Home run progress timeline
summary: Replaced the Home Run Progress display with an ordered read-only run timeline that emphasizes the current step, shows the next step, includes CSV rerun import evidence when present, and keeps raw backend progress bars collapsed behind a disclosure.
reason: The previous grouped progress-bar display made active CSV reruns hard to follow because backend checks, active work, and raw evidence had similar visual weight.
behavior_before: Home grouped raw backend progress bars by category and set the panel status to a generic check count, so operators had to infer what was happening and what would happen next.
behavior_after: Home renders a fixed CSV/import-to-evidence timeline with a large current step, dimmer completed/upcoming steps, panel status text such as Current/Next or Review, and collapsed raw backend progress evidence.

Updated Home browser smoke expectations in tests/webview/test_webview_browser_home_live_state_smoke.py.
